changes: Keep upcoming TV episodes and season premieres in the first upcoming position for a full 24 hours after their actual or normalized release time.
Use the exact air timestamp for timed releases instead of dropping them at the calendar-date boundary.
Normalize date-only TV releases to midday and apply the same 24-hour retention window.
